name: Stale Replica Read
essence: The delivery page reports packing after the primary is updated to shipped.

examples.summary: The delivery page reports packing after the primary is updated to shipped.
examples.mechanism: The replica is a separate mutable binding and its asynchronous update has not completed when the reader uses it.

ingredients.suggests: Primary and replica are independently reassigned module bindings.
The read occurs before awaiting the asynchronous copy.

examples.summary: The primary changes immediately, but a read of the replica precedes completion of its asynchronous copy..
examples.mechanism: The primary changes immediately, but a read of the replica precedes completion of its asynchronous copy.

ingredients.suggests: Primary and replica are independently mutable module bindings.
The replica is read before the asynchronous copy finishes.

examples.summary: The caller reads the replica before its pending copy is applied.
examples.mechanism: The caller reads the replica before its pending copy is applied.

ingredients.suggests: The primary and replica are separate mutable package bindings.
A goroutine applies the primary after a gate, but the caller reads beforehand.

examples.summary: The replica read sees the previous delivery status.
examples.mechanism: Primary and replica are distinct mutable status bindings. The reader uses the replica before joining the asynchronous copy.
